input.basePrompt: Chest breath <=1px, blink optional. Fixed head, outline, tail, coat markings, paws; NO wag cycle or bob. Keep seed tail shape and position fixed. If hidden, keep hidden; never add a tail above the head. Remain west facing in ALL frames including the final hold. CORRECTION: Show requested motion inside the safe silhouette. IDLE: seed pose; chest breath only, no bob/wag. Restore shared tail height; never pump it vertically. Same native dog size, coat, eyes, crisp palette; fixed camera, no props/text. Keep the head silhouette unchanged; never create a crown, antenna or tail above ears. Hidden front tail stays behind body. Side/rear tails stay complete, connected in approved pose. Use the entire transparent 40x40 canvas. Keep two clear pixels at every edge, all paws and tail complete. Preserve native dog pixel size; no cropping, shrinking, blur or detached parts. Loop smoothly to the initial pose.
